content:
The HWPX document automation was successfully implemented by manipulating XML text nodes and clearing layout caches within the ZIP-based format.
The solution unzipped the HWPX file to perform precise XML replacement across multiple <hp:t> tags, ensuring split placeholders like '{{' and 'field_name}}' were correctly handled. It implemented specific string mappings for severity levels and converted ISO dates to 'YYYY.MM.DD' format. Crucially, layout cache elements such as <hp:lineSegArray> were removed to prevent the HWPX viewer from displaying stale positioning data.
